title: Stock Market News Collector output
description: Primary output is the default dataset (one JSON object per news article). Secondary output is the OUTPUT key in the key-value store with runStatus, feedStats, and failures. The Actor always exits successfully; agents must read runStatus to detect empty or partial runs.

articles.title: News articles
articles.description: Array of normalized stock market news articles. Each item has headline, source, publishedDate, articleLink, summary, tickers, and dedupeKey. Use this as the primary output for RAG, alerts, and dashboards.

runSummary.title: Run summary
runSummary.description: JSON object at key OUTPUT. Contains runStatus (ok|partial|no_items|all_feeds_failed|error), count, feedStats, failures, and warnings. Always check runStatus when count is 0.
